scripts.build:help: node -e "console.log(['mawaqit-desktop build targets:','','  pnpm build                  frontend only (tsc + vite, feeds tauri build)','  pnpm build:linux            .deb + .rpm + AppImage  (Linux host)','  pnpm build:arch             AppImage for Arch/Manjaro  (Linux host)','  pnpm build:debian           .deb  (Linux host)','  pnpm build:fedora           .rpm  (Linux host)','  pnpm build:rpi5             native build on the Pi  (Linux arm64 host)','  pnpm build:rpi5:cross       cross-compile from x86_64 Linux (needs aarch64 cross toolchain + arm64 sysroot libs)','  pnpm build:windows          .msi + NSIS setup  (Windows host)','  pnpm build:windows:msi      .msi only  (Windows host)','  pnpm build:windows:nsis     NSIS setup only  (Windows host)','  pnpm build:macos            .app + .dmg  (macOS host)','  pnpm build:macos:universal  x86_64 + arm64 universal binary  (macOS host)','  pnpm target:rpi5            one-time: rustup target add aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu','  pnpm target:macos           one-time: rustup target add aarch64-apple-darwin x86_64-apple-darwin','  pnpm sync:version           copy package.json version into tauri.conf.json + Cargo.toml'].join('\n'))"
scripts.sync:version: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const v=require('./package.json').version;const q='\x22';const t='src-tauri/tauri.conf.json';const c='src-tauri/Cargo.toml';fs.writeFileSync(t,fs.readFileSync(t,'utf8').replace(new RegExp(q+'version'+q+': '+q+'[^'+q+']+'+q),q+'version'+q+': '+q+v+q));fs.writeFileSync(c,fs.readFileSync(c,'utf8').replace(new RegExp('^version = '+q+'[^'+q+']*'+q,'m'),'version = '+q+v+q));console.log('synced version '+v+' -> tauri.conf.json + Cargo.toml')"
scripts.build:linux: node -e "process.platform==='linux'||(console.error('build:linux requires a Linux host'),process.exit(1))" && APPIMAGE_EXTRACT_AND_RUN=1 tauri build --bundles deb,rpm,appimage
scripts.build:arch: node -e "process.platform==='linux'||(console.error('build:arch requires a Linux host (produces an AppImage that runs on Arch/Manjaro and any glibc distro)'),process.exit(1))" && APPIMAGE_EXTRACT_AND_RUN=1 tauri build --bundles appimage
scripts.build:debian: node -e "process.platform==='linux'||(console.error('build:debian requires a Linux host (deb bundling is Linux-only)'),process.exit(1))" && tauri build --bundles deb
scripts.build:fedora: node -e "process.platform==='linux'||(console.error('build:fedora requires a Linux host (rpm bundling is Linux-only)'),process.exit(1))" && tauri build --bundles rpm
scripts.build:rpi5: node -e "(process.platform==='linux'&&process.arch==='arm64')||(console.error('build:rpi5 must run on the Raspberry Pi 5 itself (Linux arm64); from x86_64 use: pnpm build:rpi5:cross'),process.exit(1))" && rustup target add aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu && tauri build --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu --bundles deb
scripts.build:rpi5:cross: node -e "(process.platform==='linux'&&process.arch==='x64')||(console.error('build:rpi5:cross must run on x86_64 Linux; on the Pi itself use: pnpm build:rpi5'),process.exit(1))" && CARGO_TARGET_AARCH64_UNKNOWN_LINUX_GNU_LINKER=aarch64-linux-gnu-gcc CC_aarch64_unknown_linux_gnu=aarch64-linux-gnu-gcc CXX_aarch64_unknown_linux_gnu=aarch64-linux-gnu-g++ AR_aarch64_unknown_linux_gnu=aarch64-linux-gnu-ar PKG_CONFIG_ALLOW_CROSS=1 PKG_CONFIG_LIBDIR=/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/pkgconfig:/usr/share/pkgconfig tauri build --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu --bundles deb
scripts.build:windows: node -e "process.platform==='win32'||(console.error('build:windows requires a Windows host (WiX/msi and NSIS bundling is Windows-only)'),process.exit(1))" && tauri build --bundles msi,nsis
scripts.build:windows:msi: node -e "process.platform==='win32'||(console.error('build:windows:msi requires a Windows host'),process.exit(1))" && tauri build --bundles msi
scripts.build:windows:nsis: node -e "process.platform==='win32'||(console.error('build:windows:nsis requires a Windows host'),process.exit(1))" && tauri build --bundles nsis
scripts.build:windows:cross: node -e "process.platform==='linux'||(console.error('build:windows:cross requires a Linux host'),process.exit(1))" && tauri build --runner $PWD/scripts/cargo-xwin-wrapper --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --bundles nsis
scripts.build:macos: node -e "process.platform==='darwin'||(console.error('build:macos requires a macOS host (app/dmg bundling is macOS-only); run pnpm target:macos once first'),process.exit(1))" && tauri build --bundles app,dmg
scripts.build:macos:universal: node -e "process.platform==='darwin'||(console.error('build:macos:universal requires a macOS host; run pnpm target:macos once first'),process.exit(1))" && rustup target add aarch64-apple-darwin x86_64-apple-darwin && tauri build --target universal-apple-darwin --bundles app,dmg
